SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, 
       s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip,
       COUNT(sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS "30 days",
       COUNT((sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND 
               sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60)) AS "31-60 days",
       COUNT((sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND 
               sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90)) AS "61-90 days",
       COUNT((sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND 
               sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120)) AS "91-120 days",
       COUNT(sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN store_returns sr ON (ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND 
                            ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND 
                            ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk)
   JOIN store s ON (ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk)
JOIN date_dim d1 ON (ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk)
JOIN date_dim d2 ON (sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk)
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, 
         s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, 
         s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100
